title: TanzoGlyph Blockchain Metadata Schema
description: Schema for validating blockchain metadata for TanzoGlyph profiles

profile_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full profile JSON

ipfs_cid.description: IPFS Content ID where the full profile is stored

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when this metadata was created

chain_id.description: Chain ID where this metadata is registered

transaction_hash.description: Transaction hash where this metadata was recorded

registry_contract.description: Contract address of the TanzoGlyph registry

profile_name.description: Name of the profile (redundant for verification)

creator_id.description: Identifier for the creator of this profile

parent_glyph.description: Parent TanzoGlyph if this is a derived profile

parent_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the parent registration

root_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the root profile in this lineage

generation.description: Generation number in the lineage (0 for root)

is_public.description: Whether this profile is publicly accessible

attribution_required.description: Whether attribution is required for derivatives

storage_proof.description: Proof of storage on decentralized systems

arweave_tx_id.description: Arweave transaction ID if backed up there

filecoin_deal_id.description: Filecoin deal ID if stored there
